description: List the flows (app builds) in your organization, newest first: id, title, timestamps, and live theme knobs. Final staff sessions also see Final's own flows, marked owner: "Final". Use a flow id with the other tools, or create_flow to start fresh. Clones of listed builds carry an upstreamUpdate field when the build they were copied from has released a newer version — review and apply it with get_upstream_update / apply_upstream_update.
name: flow_list_flows
title: List your flows
